extraction.Name: Louis Deon, Junior
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: he was issued a forced patent in fee, on September 29, 1919, to his 169.10 acre allotment, described at Lots 1 and 4 & El of the SW4,Sec. , 18,T.42N., R. 36W. ,of the 6th P.M., South Dakota; and that he did not want this patent at the time, for he was not ready for it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his allotment to Charlie Shannon, of Chadron, Nebraska, for $500.00, receiving cash for it
extraction.Buyer: Charlie Shannon, of Chadron, Nebraska, for $500.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: there were $248.00 taxes against it, which he paid out of this $500.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: railroad trainman, this constituting his sole income
extraction.NOTES: Allotment described as Lots 1 and 4 & E½ of the SW¼, Sec. 18, T.42N., R.36W., 6th P.M., South Dakota; 169.10 acres; land described as being in the bad lands; deponent states he did not sell his land for any debts incurred prior to receiving the patent in fee; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; mentally competent; health is A-No.1; has a wife and one child to support, the family having good health; document reference numbers 22204-22c& appear on document; affidavit sworn April 29, 1929
